verdict.rationale: Algolia documents 'Agent Studio,' which explicitly connects a chosen LLM to Algolia search/tools, grounds responses in live index data, and supports conversational search, shopping assistants, and content summarizers, directly matching a RAG/conversational-answer API surface. It complements this with NeuralSearch (hybrid keyword+vector) for retrieval and a documented MCP server/skills pack for agent integration. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of Agent Studio answer quality, a detailed API reference for the retrieval/answer endpoints beyond marketing-style docs, and community corroboration specific to RAG use cases.
